MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:

  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None felt like a natural next choice: the rock, punk, metal and hip-hop selections did not connect with the melodic vocal music I have been choosing.",
    "Titles such as Love Is Everything and Revelator did not give me a clear connection to my listening interests, so I would skip them rather than explore on title appeal alone."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The selections seemed to treat an interest in music albums as enough to suggest very different sounds.",
    "Greatest-hits collections did not match my intent simply because I had listened to albums called The Classic Christmas Album; the holiday connection mattered more than the idea of classics."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Several holiday albums chosen close together suggest a specific listening occasion, rather than a broad interest in any familiar music.",
    "My later choice of The New Old Fashioned matters alongside those older holiday selections: melodic vocal music feels like a stronger connection than assuming I still want Christmas music.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear connection to what I already enjoy, so uncertain matches are unlikely to draw me in."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in albums but missed the melodic vocal qualities and listening occasions that made my recent choices relevant."
}
